notes: design-system is the merged UI authority (absorbed the former ui-ux-pro-max and ui-styling skills). It spans three tracks: Decide (style/color/font selection, UX + accessibility review, backed by the bundled CSV database and BM25 search scripts), Define (three-layer token architecture, CSS variables, dark-mode theming, component state specs), and Build (shadcn/ui + Tailwind implementation, React-only). Evals cover one Decide-track positive, one Define+Build-track positive, and the genuine non-fire boundary. Note the merge INVERTED the old design-system boundary case: style/palette/typography selection now belongs to this skill and must fire. A secondary partial boundary not covered below: for Vue / React Native / Flutter the Decide track still applies but the shadcn/Tailwind Build guidance must be withheld.

evals.prompt: Help me choose a style, color palette, and font pairing for a healthcare patient dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Fires and works the Decide track. Uses the product-type style guide (healthcare: clean/accessible, soft teal + white, Lato/Source Sans) or the bundled scripts (search.py --design-system) to recommend a style, a WCAG-compliant palette expressed as semantic tokens, and a heading/body font pairing — verifying 4.5:1 contrast in both light and dark mode, designing the light/dark variants together, and steering clear of the AI anti-patterns (mesh/aurora gradients, glassmorphism-everywhere, bento grids, emoji as icons). Must NOT defer this to another skill.

evals.prompt: Set up a three-layer design token system with CSS variables for our Next.js app, then wire it into the Tailwind theme and add dark mode with shadcn/ui.
evals.expected_output: Fires and chains the Define and Build tracks. Produces primitive -> semantic -> component token layers as CSS variables (no raw hex in components), an 8pt spacing scale and typography scale, a tailwind.config mapping tokens via hsl(var(--token)) with darkMode class, and dark mode via a next-themes ThemeProvider plus toggle — using purpose-mapped dark values rather than inverted colors, pairing every themed element with a dark: variant, and testing contrast independently in both modes. Routes detail to tokens.md and implementation.md instead of inlining everything.

evals.prompt: Design the database schema and REST API for our orders service.
evals.expected_output: Should not fire. Pure backend logic, API design, and database schema work are explicitly out of scope — nothing here changes how a feature looks, feels, moves, or is interacted with, which is this skill's decision criterion.
